imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Hero section background image showing a bright, welcoming learning environment with books and natural light (hero-learning.dim_1200x600.png)
- Icon representing course enrollment with a friendly academic theme (course-icon.dim_128x128.png)

existing_features.title: Create a landing page that introduces the educational platform with a hero section, feature highlights, and call-to-action
Implement a course listing view where users can browse available educational courses with title, description, and enrollment status
Implement user enrollment functionality allowing authenticated users to enroll in courses
Create a cohesive visual theme with warm, inviting colors (avoiding blue and purple), clean typography suitable for learning, and an accessible layout that encourages engagement and focus

new_feature_requests.summary: Create backend data models for courses including course ID, title, description, instructor, and enrollment list
